name: dev-tooling-env
description: Dev tooling environment for authoring agent skills: interactive skill and test generators, deterministic Python with accuracy/edge/performance tests, a format + rubric gate, a pre-commit hook, CI, and friendly git commands for non-technical authors.

scripts.ci: npm run test && node scripts/lint.mjs && node scripts/validate-skill.mjs && node scripts/run-regression.mjs --no-record && node scripts/check-rubric.mjs && node scripts/health.mjs
